topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: I was just settling into my desk, the morning's first sip of coffee still warming my hands, when there was a knock at the door. Opening it, I found a box, neatly wrapped in paper I didn’t recognize. No card, no note—just a small, mysterious package. I set it down carefully and began to unwrap it, my fingers moving slowly, almost hesitantly. Inside, I found a beautifully crafted pen, the kind that feels solid and weighty in your hand. It was paired with a leather-bound journal, the pages unlined and waiting. As I ran my fingers over the smooth cover, a small, folded piece of paper slipped out. It was a simple message, thanking me for the lessons learned and the encouragement I had given years ago. The scent of the leather and the warmth of the gift filled the room, and I paused, the world outside my window hazy and distant.
